requirements.requirement: Research and develop strategies for generating useful signals.
requirements.verification: 12 skill-based candidate signal specifications (SIG-01..SIG-12) grounded in verified 2026 efficiency & injury/depth mechanisms.

requirements.requirement: Treat strategy evaluation as a leaderboard competition that provides rewards for top performing strategies.

requirements.requirement: Analyze single bets, parlays, and player prop bet combos.

requirements.requirement: Each strategy must pass validation gates.

requirements.requirement: Determine correlation values.

requirements.requirement: Remove luck from the equation and build strategies that are selectively skill based.
requirements.verification: 32-team Pythagorean luck decomposition (identifying DEN +2.17 luck wins vs TB -2.17 luck losses), turnover-noise filtering, CLV gate, selectivity threshold, and multiple-testing FDR correction.
